Hi all — thanks for looping me in. A couple of notes from the security side before we lock the calendar:  

1) Session scope and owners (recommended 90 minutes):
   - 15 min: high-level control mapping (what we cover in Redwood hosted/dedicated/private)
   - 40 min: encryption-at-rest/in-transit and key management (what artifacts show key rotation and KMS config)
   - 20 min: SSO/SAML/OIDC configuration, user provisioning, and SCIM evidence
   - 15 min: audit logs (retention, tamper-evidence, sample log formats) + Q&A

2) Evidence we need ahead of the call (upload to the Drive link Jordan provided):
   - Redacted access log sample (last 7 days) — filename: access-logs-sample.txt
   - KMS policy/export or screenshot of rotation schedule
   - IdP configuration export or screenshots (entity ID, assertion consumer URL, signing cert)

3) Internal participants from Redwood who will speak to each area:
   - Encryption/KMS: Evelyn Hart (security)
   - SSO & provisioning: Kimberly Park (solutions engineer)
   - Logging & retention: Neha Kapoor (technical account owner)

I can lead the encryption section and Kimberly will cover SSO. AuditPro, if you'd like to join as an observer or bring specific control questions, welcome to do so.

My availability next week (PT): Tue 04/21 10:30–12:00 or Wed 04/22 11:00–12:30 — either works for me. If you prefer Thu earlier slot, Kimberly can still cover SSO but I may need to adjust.

Evelyn Hart
